MOVIE ARCHITECTURE — CURRENT CONSENSUS AND GATES (2026-08-30 13:36Z)

CANONICAL LANDED BASIS
- Landed plan: docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md at hash b12f79c... until a reviewed successor lands.
- One shared narrative ontology for text and movies. Raw media evidence -> persistent modality observations/features -> joined proposals and critic findings -> deterministic resolution -> shared narrative graph.
- Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. Providers propose only. Fully automatic means typed alternatives, unresolved, unsupported, partial, and failed outcomes; no required human correction.

DURABLE DOCUMENTATION AWAITING CHIEF LANDING
- Component ledger cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H / f203b783 / blob eb3caa99: both reviews approve; refreshed evidence op 20260830T133120.475370Z-p41341-c0000-r52ea-h4a3a9a leaves authorization_absent as the sole blocker. Documentation only; no asset, package, model, runtime, or court is admitted.
- D2 V7 cand-1EFRM8SF43RHZ35B8NZYXCEWV7 / c9414dbc over base c8ffe86, two exact paths with blobs notes f6edf74c... and plan 8bc0aa60...: one formal review approves; scout review remains. Working-tree blobs still equal the candidate and intervening main commits did not touch its paths. Refreshed evidence leaves two already-on-main ancestor ledger rows (duplicate cand-0PDQ and authorized successor cand-7BD), scout review, and chief authorization. cand-7SR is now formally landed. V6 is superseded.

D2 SETTLED CONTENT
- Presentation is an edition playback axis, not picture PTS. PTS/DTS are independently optional; zero packet duration is unknown, not empty.
- Preserve signed ticks, origins, epochs, wrap/reset/discontinuity, gaps, and repeated occurrences.
- Mapping identity is distinct from derivation receipt; reverse may be conditional/set-valued; quantized/enclosing/refused outcomes are typed; tolerance is not equality.
- AudioSpan remains a text-first millisecond overlay. Absent timing, explicit legacy empty, packet duration unknown, mapping gap, and unlawful-conversion refusal remain distinct.

B0 CONSENSUS CANDIDATE
- Consolidated V2 is post-01M19E5YAE41979075BFHMX6ZR, superseding the initial proposal and incorporating independent time-law and rights/disclosure amendments.
- B0 is an admission package, not an adapter: A source/rights/access/use decisions; B component ledger; C normative two-acquisition-run repair specification plus deliberately synthetic oracle; D closed disclosure schema plus externally executable protocol.
- B0-C cannot claim executable typed laws. C1 owns provider-free coordinate/mapping/outcome/receipt ADTs and JVM/JS/Native laws. D0 alone becomes the first Sherlock source reader and emits the realized atlas/receipt.
- B0 closure is outcome-sensitive. Hold, Unknown, NotRun(RightsHold), and ADRReplacementRequired are valid automatic states but do not close the required Sherlock path. Closure needs an admitted exact artifact/use or an actually ratified ADR replacement that names the substitute and revises/skips D0.
- Aggregate-only is now a fixed nonsemantic allowlist with mosaic-leak review, no arbitrary/dynamic/source-derived fields, closed Passed/Failed/NotRun outcomes, and a separate rights-decision reference. Passed proves conformance only, never permission.
- Final team ACCEPT/AMEND/BLOCK and chief bead-structure/ADR disposition remain open. No source read, fetch, terms acceptance, credential, dependency, C1, or D0 work is authorized.

P1 REAL-TRANSCRIPT GATE
- v3 estimand is independently accepted and awaits chief promotion to a bounded court/integration parent; promotion is not P1 completion.
- Eligibility is outcome-independent. Y_sv is probability of any predeclared faithful or source-anchored distorted visit; omission is 1-Y_sv only for eligible cells; missing evidence is not omission; revisitation is separate.
- Promotion must spell Accessibility_v, emit typed InsufficientSupport/NotEstimated below frozen support, and derive N_sv from the same visit predicate.

SEMANTIC-CHANNEL ADMISSION
- Current main has lexical HashedNgram and TF-IDF baseline embedders, not the ratified dense ONNX/transport modules. Lexical arms remain baselines but cannot validate non-lexical semantic matching.
- If P1 depends on semantic similarity, it needs an admitted non-lexical dense provider; otherwise the result is mechanics/structural and must be labelled accordingly.
- Calibration binds provider fingerprint, query/document geometries and pair rule, views/instructions, weights, missingness, candidate generator, HSMM, corpus/protocol, and calibration model. Geometry/provider/config changes create a new calibration problem.
- Local ONNX and credentialed remote transport are separate paths. No provider, credential, package, runtime, source, or movie adapter is authorized by this finding.

STAGED ORDER — NOT AUTHORIZATION
1. Independently complete P1 and close B0.
2. C1 provider-free substrate, clock/evidence contracts, and text/timed-transcript conformance.
3. D0/D1 narrow read-only source adapter and seam migration.
4. E0 separately authorized minimal film plus real-recall question.
5. Only then broaden acquisition workers, modality ablations, and StoryAtlas consumption.
- F0/F1/F2 are evidence tiers, not permission to skip stages. No exact lawful source-film plus human-recall F2 pair is admitted.
